channel.title: Israel National News Flashes

item.title: Cpt. Eliav Haim Tzapalamus was killed during operational activity
item.description: Capt. Eliav Haim Tzapalamus, 21, from Haifa, was killed during operational activity in southern Lebanon when the Humvee he was traveling in overturned. Three other soldiers were lightly wounded.

item.title: Netanyahu surprised with 'Happy Birthday' at election rally
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu received an unexpected birthday surprise Thursday evening when hundreds of local officials, activists and public representatives broke into song to celebrate his 77th birthday.

item.title: Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus, aged 21, from Haifa, fell in combat in southern Lebanon
item.description:
In the incident in which Captain Eliav Haim Tzapalamus fell, three IDF soldiers were lightly injured.
The soldiers were evacuated to receive medical treatment at a hospital, and their families have been notified.

item.title: Jerusalem protest: Driver accelerates toward protesters
item.description:
Hundreds of haredi protesters are blocking the entrance to Jerusalem near the Chords Bridge. At the same time, dozens of protesters have gathered on Bar-Ilan Street, disrupting traffic in the area.
Police said additional forces have been called to the area and are prepared to clear the roads if necessary. Traffic police are directing drivers to alternate routes, and the public is urged to avoid the area and follow police instructions.
